cinderfall.incomplete: A death-prevention floor applied to a different actor's HP total — no cross-actor HP-floor rule element exists (P7's absence pattern applies). This effect buffs, protects, or grants actions to the Feral Bond (the companion beast) from the holder's own card. No rule-element selector in pf2e-source lets one actor's item grant a stat bonus, temp HP, an extra action, or a shared sense to a different actor's sheet -- confirmed by spot-checking real pf2e's own fully-built Animal Companion subsystem (Ranger/Druid), where virtually every companion-buff/companion-action-economy feat ships with rules: [] too.
